questions.q: What does automatic reconciliation use to decide whether to match a statement line to a system transaction?
options: A random sampling algorithm
The reconciliation rule set attached to the bank account
The bank's physical branch address
The employee's job title
questions.explain: Automatic reconciliation applies the matching rules (and any tolerance rules) in the rule set attached to that specific bank account.

questions.q: For which type of bank account is automatic reconciliation ideally suited?
options: Accounts with a high volume of transactions
Accounts with fewer than five transactions a year
Accounts that have never been reconciled before
Only payroll accounts
questions.explain: Automatic reconciliation is ideally suited for bank accounts with a high volume of transactions, where rules can resolve most routine matches.

questions.q: What happens to a statement line that automatic reconciliation cannot confidently match?
options: It is deleted from the statement
It is forced into a match with the closest available transaction
It is left unreconciled and surfaces as an exception for manual review
It automatically triggers a new bank transfer
questions.explain: Automatic reconciliation is deliberately conservative — it never forces an incorrect match, leaving unmatched lines as exceptions.

questions.q: Why would a low-volume bank account typically be a poor fit for automatic reconciliation?
options: Because low-volume accounts cannot have a GL cash account
Because the overhead of building and maintaining matching rules outweighs the time saved on so few transactions
Because automatic reconciliation only works with BAI2 files
Because low-volume accounts cannot be set up in Oracle
questions.explain: For accounts with very few monthly transactions, manual reconciliation is usually more efficient than the overhead of maintaining matching rules.

questions.q: In the Harborview Metals Inc. example, what happened to the 20 lines that didn't reconcile automatically?
options: They were silently discarded
They were force-matched to the closest transaction
They became exceptions for the Treasury team to review manually
They triggered an automatic bank account closure
questions.explain: Lines automatic reconciliation can't confidently match fall into the exception queue, exactly where manual reconciliation picks up.
